## H — Hypothesis
Preserve the old finite-role recovery prototype and its fixes on current main as an explicitly bounded research package. The controller rechecks document state, permits at most one typed recovery, snapshots requests/responses against callback mutation, rejects line-grammar boundaries, and stops on uncertain effects.

## T — Tests
On current main ea2af10f11 plus this four-commit package: 26/26 tests pass under `python3 -I`; 26/26 pass under `python3 -I -O`. Workspace index passes (160 directories); current-main merge-tree is conflict-free. These are synthetic editor-state tests, not live app tests.

## D — Data / provenance
Preserves the package, source provenance and four incremental repair commits from #7264. No archived actor scripts or payloads were replayed. Original PR/branch remain unchanged.

## C — Claim boundary
Prototype only. No model calls or native input in these tests; no GUI/backend application, independent on-disk effect, semantic role truth, performance/cost claim, or live recovery authority is established. Source proposal says apply_id is unbound, sender unassigned, acceptance pending, and author excluded from the required votes.

## U — Uncertainty / gates
Draft pending current-head CI and fresh nonauthor review. Do not merge or promote to a controller until independent semantic/disk checks and all package/application gates are met.
